rules.statement: The first defendant is not bound by the mortgage decree and consequent Fiscal's sale, as the second defendant did not furnish his address to the Registrar of Lands under section 644 of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "It is common ground that the mortgagee did not furnish his address to the Registrar of Lands. It is thus clear that the first defendant is not bound by the mortgage decree, and that the action against him fails."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 644 of the Civil Procedure Code
